text:
Read your mail from a private cache without giving callers the mailbox password. Sync, list, search and read mail, set Seen status, and subscribe an agent to new mail. Start with sync, then list.
sync [limit] [--folder <name>]: Fetch mail not yet cached, newest first; default 100. Return progress and whether more remains; use list to see cached mail. A forwarding-state error blocks default-folder sync until rebaseline; read, list and search keep working. Per-folder cache keyed by folder and UIDVALIDITY; the existing single-mailbox cache becomes the default folder's cache with no re-sync.
list [limit] [--unread] [--flag <f>] [--folder <name>]: See cached Date, From and Subject with live read/unread and a flags column, newest UID first; default 20. --unread and --flag <f> filter before the limit. Date is as sent, unverified.
  flag (string): Require this live flag; JSON flag is a string
search [text...] [--from <value>] [--to <value>] [--subject <value>] [--header Name:value] [--since <date>] [--before <date>] [--flag <f>] [--no-flag <f>] [--larger <bytes>] [--smaller <bytes>] [--limit <n>] [--folder <name>]: Server-side IMAP SEARCH: --from --to --subject --header Name:value --since --before --flag --no-flag --larger --smaller --limit, combined with AND. Free text stays local. Return cached matches, default 100; sync first to discover mail. Dates accept YYYY-MM-DD or DD-Mon-YYYY; JSON uses no_flag.
  from (string): Sender
  to (string): Recipient
  subject (string): Subject
  header (string): Name:value
  since (string): YYYY-MM-DD or DD-Mon-YYYY
  before (string): YYYY-MM-DD or DD-Mon-YYYY
  flag (string): Required flag
  no_flag (string): Excluded flag
  larger (string): Minimum raw size in bytes
  smaller (string): Maximum raw size in bytes
  text (string): Local case-insensitive cache match, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no controls
[destructive] read <uid> [--no-mark] [--folder <name>]: Get one raw mail and mark it Seen by default, cached or not. --no-mark (JSON mark_read:false) leaves it unchanged. Every read needs a live server; a lost reply may leave the mail marked. No other flags.
[destructive] publish <uid> [--folder <name>]: Copy one raw mail, with an external-content warning, to the Configuration target. Each explicit repeat copies again.
sub add <target> [/regex/]: Forward mail that arrives after this add to a destination; the old backlog is never forwarded. A missing or empty filter matches ALL mail from this account. The author's permission to send is checked at add and on each forward, and the receiver must also admit this IMAP instance. At most 20 subscriptions per creator, 100 in total.
  filter (string): Match sender addr-spec plus decoded subject; common regex subset, at most 200 characters, optional /imsu flags; no g/y
sub list: Review your subscriptions: target, creator, filter, first UID and sent and dropped counts. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including damaged rows marked invalid_state for repair. No mailbox connection. A blank line separates the cached poll-status line at the end.
[destructive] sub delete <id>: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows. To change one, delete it and add it again; the new one starts at the current UIDNEXT.
status: See the last poll and its age, and the subscription, backlog, sent, dropped and warning counts. No mailbox connection.
[destructive] mark <uids> read|unread [--folder <name>]: Set or clear Seen on the named UIDs and return a per-UID result. Ordinary IMAP admission permits this. An unknown write outcome is not retried.
  state (read|unread): Only read or unread
folders [--counts]: name and role (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, Archive); --counts adds total and unseen via STATUS.
  counts (bool): Add total and unseen counts; JSON counts is a boolean
[destructive] flag <uids> add|remove <flag...> [--folder <name>]: flagged, answered, draft, seen, a custom keyword; \Deleted refused. Ordinary admission; change only the named flags and return a per-UID observed result. Unknown writes are not retried.
  action (add|remove): Add or remove only the named flags
  flags (string): One or more flags: flagged, answered, draft, seen or a custom keyword; JSON flags is an array
headers <uids> [--folder <name>]: All headers, with a per-UID result (no Seen). External content is untrusted; answer limited to 256 KiB.
parts <uid> [--folder <name>]: The MIME tree with id, type, size, filename, inline or attachment. Sizes are encoded bytes; no Seen.
part <uid> <part-id> [--folder <name>]: Decoded, base64 for binary, 25 MB cap, no Seen. Refuse above 26214400 encoded bytes before decoding. Return what fits in the 256 KiB answer cap and label truncation.
  part_id (string): MIME leaf id from parts, e.g. 1 or 2.1

Arguments
folder (string): --folder <name> (JSON folder) on every per-mail call; default is the configured mailbox, then INBOX.
id (string): Subscription id returned by sub add
limit (int): Maximum items, 1..100; defaults are stated per method
target (string): A queue or agent whose ACL admits this IMAP instance; the author must also be admitted
uid (int): Mailbox UID, 1..4294967295, never an IMAP command or sequence number
uids (string): 123, 123,130 or 100:200, at most 1000 UIDs, with a per-UID result; duplicate UIDs refused

mode.help: Implicit verified TLS by default; plain requires explicit loopback opt-out

auth.help: App password (default) or Google XOAUTH2; no fallback

mailbox.help: Mailbox or Gmail label, Unicode accepted; default INBOX

target.help: Optional fixed publication destination; required only for publish

cache_bytes.help: Logical cache byte budget including state/temporary writes; default 67108864, range 4194304..536870912

cafile.help: Optional existing public CA trust file visible inside the sandbox

allow_plaintext.help: Explicit opt-out permitting plain mode only to loopback; default false

secrets.name: IMAP_USERNAME
secrets.help:
Account name from its provider, in imap/<instance>/env. Keep package-wide
imap/env free of account credentials when instances use different accounts.

secrets.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
secrets.help: Required with auth=password: app password from the account's security settings.

secrets.name: IMAP_CLIENT_ID
secrets.help: Required with auth=xoauth2: Google's OAuth client ID and secret for your consent app.

secrets.name: IMAP_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.help:
Required with auth=xoauth2: obtain through Google's OAuth consent flow with
https://mail.google.com/ scope and offline access. No browser flow in this agent.
